newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end firmer at 20.875/21.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end firmer at 20.875/21.00 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed firmer in active trade on Wednesday, the last day in commercial banks' two-week reserve period, dealers said.
Overnight rates finished at 20.875/21.00 percent, compared to 20.50/21.50 at opening and 19 percent at Tuesday's close.

"Banks might have had fears that overnight rates will drop at the end of the reserve period, therefore many might have decided to put money into the one-week reverse repo facility," said Karoly Barath of Postabank.
This has drained most of the excess money supply that had pushed overnight rates down on Monday and Tuesday, traders added.
The central bank's one-week reverse repo rate, reduced on Saturday by 25 basis points, stands at 20.75 percent.
Overnight rates usually drop at the end of the two-week reserve period.
